beats.summary: The office hosts Movie Monday with various movies and discussions.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Movie Monday! The only cure I know for the Monday blues is… Varsity Blues!
Pam: Movie Monday started with training videos, but we went through those pretty fast.

beats.summary: Angela and Jan express disapproval of Movie Monday, fearing it will cost jobs.

evidence.snippet: Angela: I don't approve. I don't.
Angela: Michael is going to get us all fired. You sat back and let him play that dumb movie, and now Jan is peeved off and we're all going to lose our jobs.

beats.summary: Dwight discusses his desire to take over the branch and his disloyalty to Michael.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: The decision to turn on Michael was difficult. But once I did it, I didn't look back.

beats.summary: Dwight mentions his past with Jan and his feelings about Michael.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Ever since Michael dumped Jan for Carol, Jan's been bitching out on him.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Kelly really likes to online shop.
